conditions: each engine alone on the three worker nodes, one warm-up then three timed executions, median reported; Trino 483 via the read-only Hive catalog over the same Parquet object; Kaveon via the API bridge

records.question: telemetry actions by country and industry
records.sql: SELECT country, industry, SUM(actions) AS "Total actions" FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched GROUP BY country, industry ORDER BY "Total actions" DESC LIMIT 50

records.question: telemetry queries run in Europe by country
records.sql: SELECT country, SUM(queries_run) AS "Queries run" FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched WHERE region = 'Europe' GROUP BY country ORDER BY "Queries run" DESC LIMIT 50

records.question: telemetry actions in United States by surface
records.sql: SELECT surface, SUM(actions) AS "Total actions" FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched WHERE country = 'United States' GROUP BY surface ORDER BY "Total actions" DESC LIMIT 50

records.question: telemetry actions on the Chat surface by license
records.sql: SELECT license, SUM(actions) AS "Total actions" FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched WHERE surface = 'Chat' GROUP BY license ORDER BY "Total actions" DESC LIMIT 50

records.question: telemetry actions in July 2026
records.sql: SELECT SUM(actions) AS "Total actions" FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched WHERE event_date >= '2026-01-01' AND event_date < '2027-01-01'

records.question: telemetry sessions in 2026 by country
records.sql: SELECT country, SUM(sessions) AS Sessions FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched WHERE event_date >= '2026-01-01' AND event_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY country ORDER BY Sessions DESC LIMIT 50

records.question: telemetry actions in 2025
records.sql: SELECT SUM(actions) AS "Total actions" FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched WHERE event_date >= '2025-01-01' AND event_date < '2026-01-01'

records.question: telemetry errors last 7 days
records.sql: SELECT SUM(errors) AS Errors FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched WHERE event_date >= '2026-09-07'

records.question: telemetry sessions by month
records.sql: SELECT event_date, SUM(sessions) AS Sessions FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date LIMIT 1000

records.question: trend of telemetry actions over time
records.sql: SELECT event_date, SUM(actions) AS "Total actions" FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date LIMIT 1000

records.question: what about 2026?
records.sql: SELECT surface, SUM(actions) AS "Total actions" FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched WHERE event_date >= '2026-01-01' AND event_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY surface ORDER BY "Total actions" DESC LIMIT 50

records.question: and by platform
records.sql: SELECT platform, SUM(actions) AS "Total actions" FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched WHERE event_date >= '2026-01-01' AND event_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY platform ORDER BY "Total actions" DESC LIMIT 50

records.question: only for Mobile
records.sql: SELECT platform, SUM(actions) AS "Total actions" FROM kaveon_product.kaveon_events_enriched WHERE platform = 'Mobile' AND event_date >= '2026-01-01' AND event_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY platform ORDER BY "Total actions" DESC LIMIT 50
